sonnet.problem: The True statement (the disciples ask whether Jesus is aware the Pharisees were offended) only restates the story card right before it, which already told verse 12. It tests nothing new, and a baker can't reason it out.
sonnet.rule: A True statement never just repeats the card before it.

sonnet.problem: This story card retells the full list in verse 19, which choice card 12 had just covered. It adds nothing new to the passage, so it works as a recap.
The card is only a bare quote ('Disregard them! They are blind guides.'). It has no storyteller voice or context, so the baker can't tell who 'them' is.
sonnet.rule: Short, but not stripped down. A story card still has enough of Papa Dorin's voice and enough context that the moment makes sense.
